name: LlamaLend sDOLA-long2 spot share-rate oracle liquidation
summary: The sDOLA-long2 market bound a direct CryptoFromPoolVaultWAgg oracle that multiplied a pool price by sDOLA.convertToAssets(1e18) without smoothing or a rate-change bound. In one receipt the attacker redeemed and donated through sDOLA, atomically changed that share rate, and used the resulting LLAMMA health state to hard-liquidate all 27 active borrowers.
notes: The factory NewVault event created the sDOLA-long2 controller and AMM and bound this oracle as data word 3. The AMM returned the same price_oracle_contract immediately before the incident, and no later market oracle reset occurred.

Measured as the 27 liquidated borrowers' exact pre-manipulation equity, not attacker proceeds or the receipt's gross LLAMMA trading inventory. At block 24,566,936 the positions held 9,864,443.426512786048822333 sDOLA shares. Summing floor(shares_i * 1.189042662706965487 DOLA/share) independently for each borrower gives 11,729,244.077982985551536718 DOLA; using one aggregate floor would overstate this by 11 wei. The 27 Liquidate events extinguish exactly 10,906,769.122958957524427581 crvUSD of execution-time debt, including 0.097677580952622523 accrued after the preceding-block snapshot. Valuing collateral at the closest-preceding DOLA price, $0.9953312328463403 at 1772420342, and debt at the closest-preceding crvUSD price, $0.9973260439345676 at 1772420402, gives exactly $796,878.0669860904335422913758616186241598. All 27 positions have zero x, y and debt after the receipt, loan_exists is false, and no borrower receives a collateral or stablecoin refund. Later unrelated borrower token activity is excluded.
